#Import Single Cell data

## Read .gz files
```{r}
Wt1 <- read_tsv(file ="./AlexG/data/Hh_Mesp1_E8-25_wt1.tsv.gz", col_names = T)
Wt2 <- read_tsv(file ="./AlexG/data/Hh_Mesp1_E8-25_wt2.tsv.gz", col_names = T)
Mut1 <- read_tsv(file ="./AlexG/data/Hh_Mesp1_E8-25_mut1.tsv.gz", col_names = T)
Mut2 <- read_tsv(file ="./AlexG/data/Hh_Mesp1_E8-25_mut2.tsv.gz", col_names = T)
```

## Rename genes from ENS to symbol

``` {r Assign_Genes}

genenames <- read.delim(file="./AlexG/annotation/gencode.vM15.annotation_ID_type_names.txt", header=F, sep="\t")

source("./3-code/1-seurat/matchIDtoSymbol.R")

#Use custom function to change rownames from ENS -> Symbol
Wt1 <- matchIDToSymbol2(Wt1, genenames = genenames)
Wt2 <- matchIDToSymbol2(Wt2, genenames = genenames)
Mut1 <- matchIDToSymbol2(Mut1, genenames = genenames)
Mut2 <- matchIDToSymbol2(Mut2, genenames = genenames)
```


## Convert matrix to seurat object
```{r}
source("./3-code/1-seurat/MatrixToSeurat_rmDoublet.R") # Creates Seurat object and removes doublets
source("./AlexG/code/AddDoublets.R") 
```

```{r}
Wt1 <- MatrixToSeurat_rmDoublet(Wt1, "Wt1", "Wt","./AlexG/data/Doublets/wt1_scrublet_output_table.tsv" )
Wt2 <- MatrixToSeurat_rmDoublet(Wt2, "Wt2", "Wt","./AlexG/data/Doublets/wt2_scrublet_output_table.tsv" )
Mut1 <- MatrixToSeurat_rmDoublet(Mut1, "Mut1", "Mut","./AlexG/data/Doublets/mut1_scrublet_output_table.tsv" )
Mut2 <- MatrixToSeurat_rmDoublet(Mut2, "Mut2", "Mut","./AlexG/data/Doublets/mut2_scrublet_output_table.tsv" )


# saveRDS(Wt1, "Wt1_doubletRM.rds")
# saveRDS(Wt2, "Wt2_doubletRM.rds")
# saveRDS(Mut1, "Mut1_doubletRM.rds")
# saveRDS(Mut2, "Mut2_doubletRM.rds")
```
# V5.0 Whole dataset
## Pre-processing
```{r}
merged_seurat <- merge(Wt1, y=list(Wt2, Mut1, Mut2))
merged_seurat <- JoinLayers(merged_seurat)
VlnPlot(merged_seurat, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
# ggsave("QC/VlnQC.pdf")
```

```{r}
merged_seurat <- subset(merged_seurat, nFeature_RNA < 4000 & nFeature_RNA > 500 & percent.mt < 5)
VlnPlot(merged_seurat, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"))
```

```{r}
# Cell Cycle
# Reference genes
cc.genes <- read.table("./0-R_codes/2-Ressources/Cell-Cycle_genes_scRNA-Seq_MusMusculus.txt", sep="\t", header = T,fill = TRUE)
# segregate this list into markers of G2/M phase and markers of S phase
s.genes <- cc.genes[cc.genes$CellCyclePhase == "S",1]
g2m.genes <- cc.genes[cc.genes$CellCyclePhase == "G2/M",1]
```

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)
merged_seurat <- NormalizeData(merged_seurat, verbose=F)
merged_seurat <- CellCycleScoring(merged_seurat, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = TRUE, verbose=F)
merged_seurat <- SCTransform(merged_seurat, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score", "percent.mt", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA"), verbose=F)
merged_seurat <- RunPCA(merged_seurat, assay="SCT", verbose = F)
harmonized <- RunHarmony(merged_seurat, group.by.vars = "Sample", verbose=F)
```

```{r}
ElbowPlot(merged_seurat) + ElbowPlot(harmonized, reduction='harmony')
```

```{r}
harmonized <- harmonized %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:10, verbose = F) %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:10, assay="SCT", reduction = "harmony", verbose = F) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = c(0.1, 0.2), assay = "SCT", verbose = F)
```

## Find All Markers

```{r}
findallmarkers <- FindAllMarkers(harmonized, logfc.threshold = 0.5, min.pct = 0.5, only.pos = T)
findallmarkers <- subset(findallmarkers, p_val_adj < 0.05)

findallmarkers %>%
  Extract_Top_Markers() %>%
  DoHeatmap(harmonized, .) #%>%
  #export_to_ppt(., ppt_path, width = 15, height=8)

ggsave(paste0(path, "Heatmap_FindAllMarkers_res0.1.pdf"), width = 15, height = 8)
write.csv(findallmarkers, paste0(path, "FindAllMarkers.csv"))
```

## Single R
```{r}
# Mouse gastrulation ref dataset
mouse_gastr_ext <- readRDS("./4-singlecell_reference_datasets/EmbryoSCE_extended_atlas.rds")
mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25 <- mouse_gastr_ext[ , mouse_gastr_ext$stage == "E8.25"]
rm(mouse_gastr_ext)
mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25 <- logNormCounts(mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25)
rownames(mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25) <- rowData(mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25)$mgi_symbol

# Test dataset
harmonized_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(harmonized, assay="RNA")
harmonized_sce <- logNormCounts(harmonized_sce)

# Mouse gastrulation basic
singleR_mouse_gastr <- SingleR(harmonized_sce, ref = mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25, labels=mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25$celltype_PijuanSala2019, clusters= harmonized_sce$SCT_snn_res.0.1, de.method = "wilcox", de.n = 50)
table(predicted=singleR_mouse_gastr$labels, cluster=rownames(singleR_mouse_gastr))
pdf(paste0(path, "HeatmapScoreSingleR_mouse_gastr.pdf"), width = 7, height = 6)
plotScoreHeatmap(singleR_mouse_gastr, clusters = rownames(singleR_mouse_gastr), order.by = "clusters")
dev.off()
# Mouse gastrulation extended
singleR_mouse_gastr_ext_label <- SingleR(harmonized_sce, ref = mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25, labels=mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25$celltype_extended_atlas, clusters= harmonized_sce$SCT_snn_res.0.1, de.method = "wilcox", de.n = 50,)
table(predicted=singleR_mouse_gastr_ext_label$labels, cluster=rownames(singleR_mouse_gastr))

pdf(paste0(path, "HeatmapScoreSingleR_mouse_gastr_ext.pdf"), width = 8, height = 8)
plotScoreHeatmap(singleR_mouse_gastr_ext_label, clusters = rownames(singleR_mouse_gastr), order.by = "clusters")
dev.off()
```

```{r}
harmonized$mouse_gastr_label <- factor(harmonized$SCT_snn_res.0.1, labels=singleR_mouse_gastr$labels)
harmonized$mouse_gastr_ext_label <- factor(harmonized$SCT_snn_res.0.1, labels=singleR_mouse_gastr_ext_label$labels)
```

```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=5}
p <- DimPlot(harmonized, group.by = c("SCT_snn_res.0.1","mouse_gastr_label", "mouse_gastr_ext_label")) & NoAxes()

# ggsave(paste0(path, "SingleR_UMAPs.pdf"), height = 5, width = 18, bg="transparent")
# export_to_ppt(p, ppt_path, width = 18, height = 5)
```

```{r}
# Rename Clusters
cell_type <- c("Erythroid", "Pharyngeal mesoderm", "Mesenchyme", "Erythroid", "YS endothelium", "Cardiomyocytes", "Exe endoderm")
Idents(harmonized) <- "SCT_snn_res.0.1"
names(cell_type) <- levels(harmonized)
harmonized <- RenameIdents(harmonized, cell_type)
harmonized$cell_type <- Idents(harmonized)
# Add cute colors for each cluster
cluster_colors <- c(Cardiomyocytes = "#EF6507", Erythroid = "#D1B38B", `YS endothelium`="#F2B41C", Mesenchyme = "#A5D171", `Pharyngeal mesoderm` = "#8FA2F2", `Exe endoderm` = "#FFCC9F")
```


```{r}
custom_labels <- c(
  "Erythroid",        # Bold this label
  bquote(bold("Pharyngeal mesoderm")),            # Regular
  bquote(bold("Mesenchyme")),                     # Regular
  "YS endothelium",                 # Regular
  bquote(bold("Cardiomyocytes")),   # Bold this label
  "Exe endoderm"                    # Regular
)
axis <- ggh4x::guide_axis_truncated(
  trunc_lower = unit(0, "npc"),
  trunc_upper = unit(2, "cm")
)
umap_plot <-DimPlot(harmonized, label=F) +
  labs(x="UMAP1", y= "UMAP2") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors, labels=custom_labels) +
  guides(x= axis, y= axis) &
    theme(axis.line = element_line(arrow = arrow(length=unit(0.1, "inches"))),
        axis.title = element_text(hjust = 0), 
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        rect = element_rect(fill = 'transparent'))
umap_plot
ggsave("./2-projects/2-Mesp1creGli3T_scRNAseq_Guzetta/V5/1-v5_seurat_filtering_subsetting_v5.1_v5.2/1-whole_dataset/UMAP_harmonized_whole_dataset.png", width = 6.4, height = 4, bg="transparent", dpi =1200)
export_to_ppt(umap_plot, ppt_path, width = 6.4, height = 4)
```

# V5.1 SUBSET
```{r}
v5.1 <- subset(harmonized, cell_type %in% c("Pharyngeal mesoderm", "Mesenchyme", "Cardiomyocytes"))
```

```{r}
# Cell Cycle
# Reference genes
cc.genes <- read.table("./0-R_codes/2-Ressources/Cell-Cycle_genes_scRNA-Seq_MusMusculus.txt", sep="\t", header = T,fill = TRUE)
# segregate this list into markers of G2/M phase and markers of S phase
s.genes <- cc.genes[cc.genes$CellCyclePhase == "S",1]
g2m.genes <- cc.genes[cc.genes$CellCyclePhase == "G2/M",1]
```

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)
v5.1 <- NormalizeData(v5.1, verbose=F) %>%
  CellCycleScoring(s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = TRUE, verbose=F) %>%
  SCTransform(vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score", "percent.mt", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA"), verbose=F) %>%
  RunPCA(assay="SCT", verbose = F) %>%
  RunHarmony(group.by.vars = "Sample", verbose=F)

ElbowPlot(v5.1) + ElbowPlot(v5.1, reduction='harmony')
```

```{r}
v5.1$SCT_snn_res.0.1 <- NULL; v5.1$SCT_snn_res.0.2 <- NULL
v5.1 <- v5.1 %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:10, verbose = F) %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:10, assay="SCT", reduction = "harmony", verbose = F) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = c(0.5, 0.8, 1), assay = "SCT", verbose = F)
```

```{r}
DimPlot(v5.1, group.by = grep("SCT_snn.res",colnames(v5.1@meta.data),value = T), label=T) & NoLegend()
```



## Find all markers

```{r}
path <- "2-v5.1/"
```

```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=18}
findallmarkers_v5.1 <- list()

for (res in grep("SCT_snn_res", colnames(v5.1@meta.data), value=T)) {
  Idents(v5.1) <- res
  findallmarkers <- FindAllMarkers(v5.1, logfc.threshold = 0.5, min.pct = 0.5, only.pos = T)
  findallmarkers <- subset(findallmarkers, p_val_adj < 0.05)
  findallmarkers_v5.1[[res]] <- findallmarkers
}  

pdf(paste0(path, "HeatMap_FindAllMarkers.pdf"), height = 18, width=18, bg="transparent")
for (res in grep("SCT_snn_res", colnames(v5.1@meta.data), value=T)) {
  df <- findallmarkers_v5.1[[res]]
  df %>%
    Extract_Top_Markers() %>%
    DoHeatmap(v5.1, ., group.by = res) %>%
    print()
}  
  dev.off()
  
write.csv(findallmarkers_v5.1$SCT_snn_res.0.5, paste0(path, "FindAllMarkers_V5.1_res.0.5.csv"))
Extract_Top_Markers(findallmarkers_v5.1$SCT_snn_res.0.5, data_frame = T) %>%
  write.csv(paste0(path, "FindAllMarkers_Top_Markers_V5.1_res.0.5.csv"))  
```

# v5.2
Keep clusters 0, 2, 3, 1, 4, 6
```{r}
v5.2 <- subset(v5.1, SCT_snn_res.0.5 %in%c(6, 1, 4, 3, 0, 2))
```

```{r}
# Cell Cycle
# Reference genes
cc.genes <- read.table("./0-R_codes/2-Ressources/Cell-Cycle_genes_scRNA-Seq_MusMusculus.txt", sep="\t", header = T,fill = TRUE)
# segregate this list into markers of G2/M phase and markers of S phase
s.genes <- cc.genes[cc.genes$CellCyclePhase == "S",1]
g2m.genes <- cc.genes[cc.genes$CellCyclePhase == "G2/M",1]
```

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8000 * 1024^2)
v5.2 <- NormalizeData(v5.2, verbose=F) %>%
  CellCycleScoring(s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = TRUE, verbose=F) %>%
  SCTransform(vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score", "percent.mt", "nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA"), verbose=F,  variable.features.n = 1000) %>%
  RunPCA(assay="SCT", verbose = F) %>%
  RunHarmony(group.by.vars = "Sample", verbose=F)

ElbowPlot(v5.2) + ElbowPlot(v5.2, reduction='harmony')
```

```{r}
v5.2[[grep("SCT_snn_res", colnames(v5.2[[]]), value=T)]] <- NULL
v5.2 <- v5.2 %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:6, verbose = F) %>%
  FindNeighbors(dims = 1:6, assay="SCT", reduction = "harmony", verbose = F) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = c(0.2, 0.3,0.4, 0.5), assay = "SCT", verbose = F)
```

## FindAllMarkers
```{r}
path <- "3-v5.2/"
```


```{r, fig.width=18, fig.height=18}
findallmarkers_v5.2 <- list()

for (res in grep("SCT_snn_res", colnames(v5.2@meta.data), value=T)) {
  Idents(v5.2) <- res
  findallmarkers <- FindAllMarkers(v5.2, logfc.threshold = 0.5, min.pct = 0.5, only.pos = T)
  findallmarkers <- subset(findallmarkers, p_val_adj < 0.05)
  findallmarkers_v5.2[[res]] <- findallmarkers
}  

pdf(paste0(path, "HeatMap_FindAllMarkers.pdf"), height = 18, width=18, bg="transparent")
for (res in grep("SCT_snn_res", colnames(v5.2@meta.data), value=T)) {
  df <- findallmarkers_v5.2[[res]]
  df %>%
    Extract_Top_Markers() %>%
    DoHeatmap(v5.2, ., group.by = res) + ggtitle(res) -> p
    print(p)
}  
  dev.off()
```

## Single R

```{r}
# Mouse gastrulation ref dataset
mouse_gastr_ext <- readRDS("./4-singlecell_reference_datasets/EmbryoSCE_extended_atlas.rds")
mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25 <- mouse_gastr_ext[ , mouse_gastr_ext$stage == "E8.25"]
rm(mouse_gastr_ext)
mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25 <- logNormCounts(mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25)
rownames(mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25) <- rowData(mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25)$mgi_symbol

# Test dataset
v5.2_sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(v5.2, assay="RNA")
v5.2_sce <- logNormCounts(v5.2_sce)

# Mouse gastrulation basic
singleR_mouse_gastr <- SingleR(v5.2_sce, ref = mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25, labels=mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25$celltype_PijuanSala2019, clusters= v5.2_sce$SCT_snn_res.0.5, de.method = "wilcox", de.n = 50)
table(predicted=singleR_mouse_gastr$labels, cluster=rownames(singleR_mouse_gastr))

# pdf(paste0(path, "HeatmapScoreSingleR_mouse_gastr_v5.2.pdf"), width = 7, height = 6)
# plotScoreHeatmap(singleR_mouse_gastr, clusters = rownames(singleR_mouse_gastr), order.by = "clusters")
# dev.off()
# Mouse gastrulation extended
singleR_mouse_gastr_ext_label <- SingleR(v5.2_sce, ref = mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25, labels=mouse_gastr_ext_e8.25$celltype_extended_atlas, clusters= v5.2_sce$SCT_snn_res.0.5, de.method = "wilcox", de.n = 50,)
table(predicted=singleR_mouse_gastr_ext_label$labels, cluster=rownames(singleR_mouse_gastr))

# pdf(paste0(path, "HeatmapScoreSingleR_mouse_gastr_ext_v5.2.pdf"), width = 8, height = 8)
# plotScoreHeatmap(singleR_mouse_gastr_ext_label, clusters = rownames(singleR_mouse_gastr), order.by = "clusters")
# dev.off()
```

```{r}
v5.2$mouse_gastr_label_v5.2 <- factor(v5.2$SCT_snn_res.0.5, labels=singleR_mouse_gastr$labels)
v5.2$mouse_gastr_ext_label_v5.2 <- factor(v5.2$SCT_snn_res.0.5, labels=singleR_mouse_gastr_ext_label$labels)

v5.2_sce$mouse_gastr_label_v5.2 <- factor(v5.2_sce$SCT_snn_res.0.5, labels=singleR_mouse_gastr$labels)
v5.2_sce$mouse_gastr_ext_label_v5.2 <- factor(v5.2_sce$SCT_snn_res.0.5, labels=singleR_mouse_gastr$labels)
```
